changes.name: GNO — Girls Night Out (South Side Cycling Club)
changes.description: The shop and South Side Cycling Club run this Wednesday night ride as a welcoming community of women. Four groups leave at once, from a beginner group aiming for 10 miles in about 1 hour 45 minutes up to 16+ mph, and routes change weekly. Helmets and lights required; arrive early to sign the waiver. From November 11 to March 17 Wednesday nights turn into Winter Wednesdays: strength and mobility, bike maintenance clinics and social outings instead of rides. The shop also runs a Saturday 8 am training ride through October 31.
